name: ValidUser
description: Fix mentions for unknown users showing up as '@unknown-user' (hover over a mention to fix it)
notes: Hovering an "@unknown-user" mention asks Discord for that user (GET /users/{id}), at most five waiting at a time, newest first, one every 300 ms, waiting out rate limits, and the message then shows their name; a mention of a user Qord already knows is fixed at once. Clicking a mention opens the profile.
gaps: Upstream also fills in the fetched user's profile badges (from their flags) for Discord's popout; Qord's profile loads the user's real profile instead
